opening: I've been feeling sick to my stomach.
I've been unsteady on my feet when I walk.
All of this started 10 days ago.
It's so bad that I can't stand up without help.
These have all been getting worse.
I've had my first dose of the Sinopharm COVID-19 vaccine.

opening.text: I've been feeling sick to my stomach, my speech has become slurred, and I've been unsteady on my feet when I walk. All of this started 10 days ago and has been getting worse. It's so bad that I can't stand up without help. I've had my first dose of the Sinopharm COVID-19 vaccine.
